title: Crowned Green Dog
description: A vibrant surreal painting features a large lime-green dog in profile wearing an ornate golden crown with glowing orbs. To the right, a young boy with closed eyes rests against the dog's shoulder. The background consists of swirling psychedelic spirals in blue, orange, and purple, with floating orbs on the left and intricate dark blue patterns on the right.
